SQ_START_SQL.title: Open the Simple Quote at the next quarter hour (START_DATE)
SQ_START_SQL.instructions: In DBeaver (SIT connection only), the user's SQL with START_DATE only: UPDATE NGEP_SIT.SC_QUOTE mp SET START_DATE = TO_DATE('{NEXT_QUARTER}', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE mp.QUOTE_NO IN ('{SQ}'); COMMIT;  --Check: SELECT mp.QUOTE_NO, mp.START_DATE, mp.END_DATE FROM NGEP_SIT.SC_QUOTE mp WHERE mp.QUOTE_NO IN ('{SQ}');  Do NOT change END_DATE yet. Then wait until {SQ} shows in the supplier's Simple Quote Respond list. Time rule (user, 2026-11-23): always the nearest upcoming quarter hour (:00, :15, :30, :45), e.g. 16:04 → 16:15; SIT processes SQ dates on the quarter (CHANGED_DATE = END_DATE + 1 min for SQ…2305/2309).
SQ_START_SQL.source: User SQL template (2026-11-23: UPDATE NGEP_SIT.SC_QUOTE mp SET START_DATE/END_DATE = TO_DATE(..) WHERE mp.QUOTE_NO IN (..)) + memory sq-date-sql-procedure (START first, END after the reply)
SQ_START_SQL.sql: UPDATE NGEP_SIT.SC_QUOTE mp SET START_DATE = TO_DATE('{NEXT_QUARTER}', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE mp.QUOTE_NO IN ('{SQ}')

SQ_END_SQL.title: Close the Simple Quote at the next quarter hour (END_DATE) — only after the supplier replied
SQ_END_SQL.instructions: Only after the supplier replied. In DBeaver (SIT connection only), the user's SQL with END_DATE only: UPDATE NGEP_SIT.SC_QUOTE mp SET END_DATE = TO_DATE('{NEXT_QUARTER}', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE mp.QUOTE_NO IN ('{SQ}'); COMMIT;  --Check: SELECT mp.QUOTE_NO, mp.START_DATE, mp.END_DATE FROM NGEP_SIT.SC_QUOTE mp WHERE mp.QUOTE_NO IN ('{SQ}');  Then wait until the Prepare Request Note task for {SQ} appears in the requisitioner's My Task. Time rule (user, 2026-11-23): always the nearest upcoming quarter hour (:00, :15, :30, :45), e.g. 16:04 → 16:15; SIT processes SQ dates on the quarter (CHANGED_DATE = END_DATE + 1 min for SQ…2305/2309).
SQ_END_SQL.source: User SQL template (2026-11-23: UPDATE NGEP_SIT.SC_QUOTE mp SET START_DATE/END_DATE = TO_DATE(..) WHERE mp.QUOTE_NO IN (..)) + memory sq-date-sql-procedure (START first, END after the reply)

PO_LOOKUP.title: Purchase Order number after iGFMAS verification
PO_LOOKUP.instructions: iGFMAS creates the PO some time after {PR} is approved (about 1 h on 2026-11-16). Find it in DBeaver (NGEP_SIT.FL_FULFILMENT_REQUEST / FL_FULFILMENT_ORDER) or Task Status Search, then: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate PO_LOOKUP --set PO=PO26…

DO_LOOKUP.title: Delivery Order number in the receiving officer's Group Task
DO_LOOKUP.instructions: The delivery submitted against {PO|CO} becomes a Delivery Order (e.g. 01309H005M2600503) in the receiving officer's Group Task. Find it there or in DBeaver, then: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate DO_LOOKUP --set DO=<number>

LA_LOOKUP.title: Letter of Acceptance to build on
LA_LOOKUP.instructions: Give an LA that is already verified by the Desk Officer (KAT-010/027) and belongs to your test data: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate LA_LOOKUP --set LA=LA26…

CT_LOOKUP.title: Contract (or its LOA) for a Contract Request
CT_LOOKUP.instructions: KAT-057 picks the contract by its LOA number (ContractList). Give the LA of a contract whose FD and agreement are approved: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate CT_LOOKUP --set LA=LA26…

DN_LOOKUP.title: Debit Note created by SIT for an invoice above the order
DN_LOOKUP.instructions: SIT creates a Debit Note when the invoice amount is above the order ({PO|CO}); the runner reads it from FL_ADJUSTMENT. By hand: npm run qa -- gate --run {RUN} --gate DN_LOOKUP --set DN=DN26…
